text:
maria_cs: Heads-up: FluxSure (mid-market insurer) submitted an intake to onboard a custom sequence tagging model for multi-entity extraction from claims. They require strict PHI controls, private deployment (VPC), and we need to validate with our safety and regression evals. They flagged renewal leverage if delivery slips past 6 weeks.

jamie_am: FYI — they're in renewal talks; sales asked for firm go-live estimate. Can we give a realistic timeline?

raj_se: Quick tech clarifiers: are they asking for an adapter (LoRA) or full fine-tune? Expected qps? token lengths? Any constraints on GPU type?

maria_cs: Customer prefers LoRA-first, but open to full fine-tune for performance. Data: ~80k labeled spans, many long documents up to 6k tokens, peak ~15 req/s. They want inference on A10G-equivalent or better.

olivia_privsec: Must confirm BAA and exact retention/backup rules. Private deployment + customer-managed KMS required. Ask whether they need audit logs forwarded to their SIEM.

ai_safety: We'll need: 400 labeled examples, 40 adversarial prompts, and prompt-to-label mapping. We'll run hallucination checks, label consistency, and over-redaction regression. Upload checklist: https://redwood-internal/safety/checklists/fluxsure-ner

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CB-5012 FluxSure custom-extract onboarding. Owner: @raj_se. Infra prep ETA 4 business days.

raj_se: Proposed plan: 1) infra + VPC peering 2) staging deploy with LoRA adapter 3) run safety/regression evals 4) canary traffic ramp. Need small S3 bucket with sanitized samples and a service account for the dev token.

jamie_am: Sales asks that we prioritize the enablement call this week; they're pushing for an in-week demo. I'll coordinate calendar.

maria_cs: Scheduling enablement Tue 3pm PT. @olivia_privsec can you join the PHI controls segment? @ai_safety please share eval rubric before the call.

olivia_privsec: On it. Also confirm whether HSM-backed KMS is mandatory; if yes, that adds 2-3 days for infra provisioning.

ai_safety: Draft rubric attached to checklist link. Key metrics: false negative rate on NAME/SSN tags, false positive rate on non-PHI, and redaction delta. We'll want baseline eval on their dev set and adversarial pass.

raj_se: Example staging config snippet for reference:
```
model_variant: fluxsure-ner-lora
sequence_length: 6144
batching: dynamic
quantize: false
max_workers: 8
```
We'll tune after seeing the sample distribution.

jamie_am: Noted renewal risk. Looping in @sales-bot to flag for upsell/discount discussion.

sales-bot: Noted. Sales flagged potential renewal discount if go-live before quarter-end. Created sales-opportunity link: https://crm/opp/FS-382.

maria_cs: Thanks team. I'll post meeting notes here after the enablement call and attach the signed BAA when available.
